# `in`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if `expr` equals to any valN.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
expr1 in(expr2, expr3, ...)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- in, example 1
> SELECT 1 in(1, 2, 3);
true
```

```sql
-- in, example 2
> SELECT 1 in(2, 3, 4);
false
```

```sql
-- in, example 3
> SELECT named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2) in(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 1), named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 3));
false
```

```sql
-- in, example 4
> SELECT named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2) in(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2), named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 3));
true
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
